# Test Fixtures

Sample documents for testing the DocuExtract extraction engine. All files are MIT-licensed or public-domain samples with no real PII.

## Invoices

| File | Format | Complexity | Source |
|------|--------|------------|--------|
| `invoice_simple_01.jpg` | JPEG | Simple, single-page | Azure Form Recognizer SDK test fixtures (MIT) |
| `invoice_simple_01.pdf` | PDF | Simple, single-page | tabula-java test resources (MIT) |
| `invoice_lines_02.jpg` | JPEG | With line items | Nexdata-AI English Invoice dataset |
| `invoice_lines_02.pdf` | PDF | With line items, multi-field | Azure Form Recognizer SDK test fixtures (MIT) |
| `invoice_detailed_03.jpg` | JPEG | Detailed, complex layout | Nexdata-AI English Invoice dataset |
| `invoice_detailed_03.pdf` | PDF | Multi-page (3 pages) | Azure Form Recognizer SDK test fixtures (MIT) |
